summary: Output flags (--csv, --plain, --select, --quiet) must act on the records inside the IPA {result, data} envelope, and every hand-written command must route them through printOutputWithFlags; the JSON output shape stays unchanged.
reason: Every IPA web service wraps its payload in {result:{cod_err,...}, data}, so top-level renderers saw one wrapper object (CSV fell back to raw JSON, --select returned {}); hand-written commands printed their own JSON envelope or human text and skipped the shared renderer.
validated_outcome: Live 2026-10-17 over 35 read commands: --csv/--plain/--quiet honored on all, --select no longer returns {} on WS commands; --json and piped output byte-identical to 2026.10.1 on all 35.
